zh.summary: 達美航空執行長巴斯蒂安公開批評希斯洛機場（LHR）決定2028年將達美航空遷往第四航廈、與維珍大西洋航空分開，稱此舉「短視」且「對航空消費者不利」，並表示將力抗這項決定。

body: 本期彙整2則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。部分內容摘自近期站內報導，原文與來源見文末。

facts.claim: The CE-25A fixed-wing electric commercial aircraft completed its first piloted test flight on November 14, 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: fixed-wing electric commercial aircraft, the CE-25A, completed its first piloted test flight on November 14, 2026

facts.claim: The CE-25A, developed by state-owned aerospace manufacturer COMAC, is designed to carry up to 19 passengers plus crew.
facts.sourceQuote: Developed by state-owned aerospace manufacturer COMAC, the CE-25A has a maximum takeoff weight of 10 metric tons and is designed to carry up to 19 passengers plus crew

facts.claim: The aircraft took off and landed in Binzhou, Shandong province, southeast of Beijing.
facts.sourceQuote: The aircraft took off and landed in Binzhou, in Shandong province, southeast of Beijing

facts.claim: Two pilots and a flight test engineer were on board.
facts.sourceQuote: with two pilots and a flight test engineer on board

facts.claim: The aircraft spent 16 minutes and 38 seconds in the air.
facts.sourceQuote: It spent 16 minutes and 38 seconds in the air

facts.claim: According to Chinese state media, the aircraft had been flying for months, with 19 uncrewed flights completed.
facts.sourceQuote: According to Chinese state media, the aircraft had in fact been flying for months, with 19 unmanned flights completed
